A magical sword forged in the frigid mountains of the Hebra region. When the blade glows blue, enemies struck by it will become frozen.|Inventory|BotW}} ==Location and Uses== {{BotW Item Properties/Store |type = Weapon |strength = 20 |durability = 30 |flammable = No |magnetic = Yes |buoyant = No |conductive = Yes |guardian = No |throw = Yes |throw_effect = }} {{Compendium/Extract|Frostblade}} Frostblade are magical swords that were forged in the [[Hebra Mountains]]. They belong to the [[Magic Gear]] equipment archetype, which is a series of [[Weapon]]s with elemental properties.{{Cite Book|quote= |book= CaC|publisher= |page= 174}} [[Enemy|Enemies]] struck by their blade while they are glowing blue will be frozen. Equipping a Frostblade lowers [[Link]]'s temperature by the equivalent of one level of [[Heat Resistance]], but they are ineffective against [[Fire]] or [[Scorching Climate]]s. Frostblades can commonly be found in the [[Gerudo Highlands]] and [[Hyrule Field]]. Frostblades one-shot Fire elemental Enemies, such as [[Fire-Breath Lizalfos]] and [[Fire Wizzrobe]]s.{{Cite|{{Big|Elemental Weaknesses}}
If you use an icy attack against a fiery enemy, you may defeat it in one hit.|Tips and Tricks|BotW}} Being made of metal, Frostblades can attract [[Lightning]] when equipped during a [[Thunderstorm]] and conduct [[Electricity]]. They sink if they are dropped in [[Water (Terrain)|Water]], but they can also be picked up using the [[Sheikah Slate]]'s [[Magnesis]] [[Rune]].
